notes.title: SUPPORTER EDITION, ACHIEVEMENTS AND 90.000 DOWNLOADS
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you so much for this month![/h3]
First of all, we want to express our heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you for your incredible support over the past month. Your enthusiasm and dedication mean a lot to us.

[h3]Introducing the Supporter Edition[/h3]
For those of you who want to support the developers and take your gaming experience to the next level, we are proud to introduce the Supporter Edition. This special edition includes official 10-page game design document (signed digital copy), final original soundtrack, special Discord role, and thank you letter.

[h3]Achievements are now available[/h3]
We are also happy to announce that achievements have been added to the game! Only 1% of players were able to get the latest achievement.

[h3]Thanks for 90,000 downloads[/h3]
We are incredibly happy to announce that our game has been downloaded 90,000 times! This important milestone would not have been possible without your support, and we are deeply grateful to each and every one of you. Your enthusiasm motivates us to continue working on games.

[h3]Constant development[/h3]
Rest assured, we are committed to constantly developing and improving our game. We have one big update and free DLC planned in the future and we are always happy to hear your feedback.

[h3]Join our Discord community[/h3]
If you want to keep up with the latest news and updates, or just chat with other players, be sure to join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/Ga3rbMHcHH.

Thank you for your continued support and wish you a fantastic gaming experience!

Stay tuned for updates and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Version 1.12305ab.01 update and 15,000 players
notes.content:
We are proud to announce that our game has already attracted 15,000 players! We thank each of you for your support and participation. This success inspires us to continue working and improving the game.

[b]Improved game balance[/b]
One of the most important changes in this update was the improvement in game balance. We analyzed player feedback and identified several minor anomalies that could make the game difficult to complete. As a result:

- Most of the minor anomalies have been removed.
- Now the game has become easier and more comfortable for most users.
We are confident that these changes will make your gaming experience smoother and more fun.

[b]Reworked difficulty level "Very Easy"[/b]
For those who prefer a relaxing game, we have made changes to the "Very Easy" difficulty level. In the new version:

- Now you will only have 10 hearts.

This setting makes the game less demanding and is ideal for new players or those who want to enjoy gameplay without unnecessary complexity.

[b]UI fix[/b]
We know how important it is for your game to look great on all devices, so we:

- Fixed UI scaling on ultra-wide monitors.
- We added a permanent hint to the menu so that you can always quickly get the information you need.

Now the interface is correctly upscaled and looks clear and comfortable on screens with different aspect ratios, which significantly improves the visual perception of the game.

We continue to work to improve our product and are always ready to listen to your feedback. Thank you for your support and wish you a pleasant game!

If you want to support the game, then subscribe to our discord server: https://discord.gg/Ga3rbMHcHH

Stay tuned for new updates and stay tuned!
